slides.headline: Public cruise or private charter? Here's how to pick.
slides.body: Same boat, same lake. The right one depends on your group size and how you feel about strangers.

slides.headline: Public cruise
slides.body: $59 to $69 a person. You share the boat with other groups. Same captain, same lake, same BYOB rules.

slides.headline: You're a small crew or a couple.
slides.body: Four friends, a date night, or a birthday that isn't a whole production. Book seats and bring the cooler.

slides.headline: Private charter
slides.body: $800 to $950 for the whole boat, up to 26 guests. Weekday discounts available. Nobody on board you didn't invite.

slides.headline: It's a bachelorette, birthday, or team.
slides.body: Your playlist, your pace, your people. A $150 deposit holds the boat, and the rest is due by tour time.

slides.headline: $800 split 20 ways is $40 each.
slides.body: Compare that to one round at a Houston bar for the same 20 people. Then remember you brought your own drinks.

slides.headline: Same roof. Same bathroom. Same captain.
slides.body: Both run on a covered boat with Bluetooth speakers, party lights, and a professional captain at the wheel.

slides.headline: Cancel 48+ hours out for a full refund.
slides.body: Inside 48 hours there's no refund. If we cancel for weather, you get a full refund or a free reschedule.

slides.headline: Small crew? Public. Big occasion? Private.
slides.body: Not sure? Text us your group size and date, and we'll tell you straight.

slides.headline: Pick your cruise. Bring the cooler.
slides.body: Public cruises and private charters on Clear Lake. Book at houstonpedalbarge.com.
